GSAP 3.15.0 — vendored for LEXICON VI
======================================

gsap.min.js and Flip.min.js are unmodified builds from the official `gsap`
npm package (https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap), Copyright (c) 2008-2026,
GreenSock. All rights reserved.

They are distributed under GreenSock's standard "no charge" license:
https://gsap.com/standard-license

Since GSAP's acquisition by Webflow, all plugins (including Flip) are free
for commercial use; no membership or license key is required.
